<script>

$(document).ready(function () {
$(document).ready(function () {

    function getUrlParams() {
        var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        return {
            msg_flash: params.get('msg'),
            type_flash: params.get('flash')
        };
    }

    function removeUrlParams() {
        // Get the current URL without query parameters
        var newUrl = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + window.location.pathname;
        
        // Use history.replaceState to remove the parameters from the URL without reloading the page
        window.history.replaceState({ path: newUrl }, '', newUrl);
    }

 
        var params = getUrlParams();

        // If msg_flash and type_flash are available, show the flash message
        if (params.msg_flash && params.type_flash) {
            showFlashMessage(params.type_flash, params.msg_flash);
            
            // Remove the parameters from the URL after using them
            removeUrlParams();
        }
        
        
        

    });     
    });     
        

</script>
